name: us-crypto-tax
description: Work out a US individual's 2026 federal tax on cryptocurrency and other digital assets, and report it. Covers property treatment under Notice 2014-21, the taxable events (sales, crypto-to-crypto swaps, spending), income on receipt at fair market value for mining, staking (Rev. Rul. 2023-14), airdrops and hard forks (Rev. Rul. 2019-24), DeFi yield and rewards, basis by wallet under Rev. Proc. 2024-28 with specific identification or FIFO, Form 8949 digital asset boxes G to L, 2026 Form 1099-DA broker reporting (gross proceeds for all sales, basis for covered assets acquired after 2025 in a custodial account, the USD 10,000 stablecoin and USD 600 NFT and payment de minimis rules, no staking rewards on the form), the repealed DeFi broker rule, Form 8300 relief, FBAR and Form 8938, gifts, donations with a qualified appraisal above USD 5,000, theft and lost keys, and records. Trigger on "crypto tax", "bitcoin", "ethereum", "staking", "mining", "airdrop", "DeFi", "Form 1099-DA", "Form 8949 di
